$comment: Accepted npm audit advisories for the release security gate (tools/audit-gate.mjs). Every entry needs a concrete justification and an expiry date; expired entries stop being accepted automatically. Triage notes live in docs/testing/security-audit.md.

advisories.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
advisories.justification: image-size is only reachable through pptxgenjs, a devDependency used by the fixture-generation toolchain. It is never bundled into shipped desktop artifacts (apps/mdt build.files packages out/** only), so the parser is not exposed to untrusted input in production. No fixed version of pptxgenjs is available yet; re-triage on expiry.

advisories.title: image-size: JXL and HEIF parsers allow denial of service through infinite loops
advisories.justification: Same exposure as GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr: dev-only fixture toolchain via pptxgenjs, never bundled into shipped artifacts. Re-triage on expiry or when pptxgenjs bumps image-size above 2.0.2.
